directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the importance of building trust between employers and employers. You can cite examples to illustrate your views. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
sample_essay:
Building trust between employers and employees is of utmost significance in the workplace. To begin with, trust enhances productivity. When employees trust their employers, they are more likely to be motivated and committed to their work. For example, in a company where the management is open and honest with employees about the company's goals and strategies, employees will feel more involved and work harder to achieve those goals.

In addition, trust fosters a positive work environment. A workplace filled with trust means less conflict and more cooperation. When employers trust their employees to make decisions and complete tasks independently, it shows respect for their abilities. This, in turn, makes employees feel valued and respected, leading to a more harmonious and efficient work atmosphere.

Furthermore, trust is crucial for long-term business success. If employees trust their employers, they are more likely to stay with the company, reducing turnover rates. A stable workforce allows a company to retain valuable knowledge and experience, which is essential for continuous growth.

In conclusion, building trust between employers and employees is not only beneficial for individual employees but also for the overall success of the business. It is an investment that pays off in the long run.
